description: This file defines the class Kint_Objects_Closure, which extends KintObject and provides functionality for parsing PHP Closure variables, extracting their parameters, used variables, and source location.

classes.name: Kint_Objects_Closure
classes.description: A class representing PHP Closure objects, capable of parsing their metadata such as parameters, used variables, and source location.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a Closure variable to extract parameters, used variables, and source information, returning an array with this metadata.
